title: Genius Sports launches Prediction.com, the premium prediction market platform for comparing probabilities, event contracts and insights
body_markdown:
- Genius Sports-owned Legend launches[Prediction.com](https://prediction.com/) **.**
- Platform combines live sports data feeds with prediction market volumes and event contract data.
- Users can compare equivalent contracts and multi-leg combinations across multiple venues.


Genius Sports Limited (“Genius Sports”) (NYSE:GENI), a global leader in real-time sports data and technology, today launched[Prediction.com](https://prediction.com/) , a new consumer platform that enables users to discover prediction markets, compare equivalent event contracts across multiple platforms and follow how market probabilities change as events unfold.


**Prediction.com** brings markets and pricing from major prediction platforms into a single destination, allowing users to see how equivalent contracts are priced across different venues. The platform also brings comparison to the fast-growing multi-leg segment through a proprietary cross-venue, multi-leg pricing engine.


The platform has been launched through **Legend** , Genius Sports’ consumer media and technology business, whose operations include a portfolio of leading sports brands reaching millions of fans. **Prediction.com** builds on Legend’s existing consumer and comparison technology while creating a new flagship brand for the rapidly expanding prediction market category.


For sports markets, **Prediction.com** combines Genius Sports’ live game data with real-time prediction market pricing. Its in-game experience allows fans to follow play-by-play action alongside changing probabilities, prices and market signals, creating a single destination for discovering markets before an event and tracking them as the action unfolds.


Genius Sports already provides official sports data and integrity services to leading prediction market platforms, helping power and safeguard sports-related markets with trusted, real-time information.


**Prediction.com** gives consumers one place to discover and compare a growing universe of prediction markets. This category is expanding rapidly, but the consumer experience remains fragmented. **Prediction.com** brings it together, combining Legend’s consumer technology with Genius Sports’ live data to make prediction markets easier to understand, compare and follow.


For prediction market platforms, **Prediction.com** provides a new destination through which consumers can discover markets and compare the information available across platforms. For Genius Sports, it creates a direct consumer presence at an increasingly important point in the prediction market journey: where users discover markets, compare contracts and pricing, follow live events and track outcomes.


**Prediction.com** will continue to expand its coverage, functionality and partner integrations as the global prediction market ecosystem develops.
